_about: Who owns each checklist task, and how the client form names it. owner: client tasks get To do / Working on it / Done on the form; npsa tasks show read-only there and are updated from the Grant Writing page or intake_seed. title is the client-facing wording (the catalog label stays the internal name). hint is the quiet line under a client task. retired: the task no longer shows or counts anywhere (its keys stay in the catalog so old answers load). default + unless: the status a task starts at until someone sets one, unless the state program needs it (vendor quotes are off unless a program requires quotes; the team switches them on for items with no clear price). 2026-09-25.
